claim: public.pos_item_sales (migration cost_of_goods_reads_what_sold, ADR 0298 decision 8) reads qty, price and inventory_id at the top level of each pos_checks line. The gateway's only pos_checks writer, apps/api-gateway/src/pos-hub/pos-hub.service.ts, writes those three keys on every line it builds, from the canonical line and its resolved mapping. A rename, a nesting or a dropped key fails the build here, before every line reads as unmapped.
